en.headline: Fatal traffic accidents rise 44% in first half of 2026
en.dek: Police recorded 59 fatal crashes and 63 deaths, up sharply from a year earlier, while overall injury accidents continued their long-term decline; a three-week enforcement drive has begun.
body: Hong Kong saw a 44 per cent year-on-year increase in fatal traffic accidents in the first half of 2026, with 59 fatal crashes claiming 63 lives, police said on Wednesday. The number of deaths rose 47 per cent from 43 in the same period last year.

Pedestrians accounted for 26 of the fatalities (41 per cent), of whom 18 were aged 65 or above. Commercial vehicles were involved in 41 of the fatal accidents, a 58 per cent rise, and nearly four in ten of those drivers were 65 or older. Overall injury accidents fell 17 per cent to 7,341 and serious-injury-or-fatal cases dropped 39 per cent to a level that continues a decade-long downward trend.

Police attributed many of the fatal cases to inattentive driving and pedestrians crossing carelessly. They have launched a three-week citywide operation from 3 to 23 August targeting distracted driving and pedestrian offences, and reiterated support for tightening mandatory medical checks for commercial drivers from age 70 to 65.

zh.headline: 上半年致命交通意外升44% 共63人死亡
zh.dek: 警方錄得59宗致命車禍，死亡人數較去年同期升47%；整體傷亡意外則繼續下降，並展開為期三周的專題執法行動。
body: 警務處交通總部周三公布，2026年上半年本港共發生59宗致命交通意外，較去年同期的41宗上升44%，造成63人死亡，按年增加47%。
死者中行人佔最多，共26人（41%），其中18人為65歲或以上長者。涉及商用車輛的致命意外有41宗，按年升58%，當中近四成司機為65歲或以上。整體涉及傷亡的交通意外則跌17%至7,341宗，嚴重受傷及致命意外跌39%至193宗，延續過去十年下降趨勢。
警方指主要成因包括司機不專注駕駛及行人胡亂過馬路，已於8月3日至23日展開為期三周的全港專題執法行動，重點打擊不專注駕駛及行人違例。警方亦支持將商用車輛司機強制體檢年齡門檻由70歲降至65歲的立法建議。
